title: The Obliteration Room (Please Cover Everything)
summary: A white room fills the browser and the crowd buries it under dots, one anonymous checkbox at a time; reload re-whitens it.
mechanism: Pure CSS checkbox-hack (:checked on labelled <input type=checkbox>), zero JavaScript; a responsive auto-fill grid is the room and reload is the only reset.
references: the CSS checkbox-hack / zero-JavaScript net.craft tradition
